metric: median rendered mesh depth overlap count divided by observed in-image point count; subject-equal on fixed V2 VAL
selection_guard: coverage may not fall more than 0.02 below Official

common_coverage_paired_error.reason: Existing fixed evaluation reports contain per-model overlap coverage and surface error, but no persisted intersection mask shared across comparators. Separate coverage and error therefore must not be interpreted as an exact common-pixel paired test.

interpretation: Coverage improves on V2 VAL and does not explain the selected checkpoint's lower median error as simple loss of supported pixels. A strict same-pixel claim remains unavailable until the common-coverage audit is run.

new_v2_sealed.interpretation: Aggregate coverage is above Official and below Historical V1 E1 by 0.0058. This rejects a gross aggregate coverage-collapse explanation but does not prove equal common-pixel support.
